story_type: litter hoist off a bulk carrier in heavy seas, filmed air to air
hook: Waves broke over this ship 200 miles out, and a crewman was hurt.
narration: A Coast Guard helicopter hung beside a ship taking waves over its deck, two hundred nautical miles out.
It was the bulk carrier Sakizaya Queen, off North Carolina, on March sixth, twenty twenty-five.
One of its crewmembers had been injured.
A Jayhawk from Air Station Elizabeth City went for him, while a Coast Guard C-130J filmed from above.
That helideck is marked for four tons. A Jayhawk weighs far more than that, so the crew works from a hover, on the hoist cable.
On deck, they got the injured man into a litter as the sea kept coming over the side.
[short pause] Then the cable lifted the litter up, past the breaking waves.
outcome: The aircrew pulled the injured crewmember aboard and flew him away from the ship.
title: Waves over the deck, 200 miles out
description:
On March 6, 2025, a Coast Guard Air Station Elizabeth City MH-60T helicopter crew medevaced an injured crewmember from the bulk carrier Sakizaya Queen about 200 nautical miles offshore of North Carolina, filmed from an Air Station Elizabeth City C-130J.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class David Weydert, Air Station Elizabeth City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/954932/uscg-air-station-elizabeth-city-medevac-off-sakizaya-queen-b-roll
